Aster Pharmacy is owned by Aster DM Healthcare, which was founded by Dr. Azad Moopen. The ownership is split by region: a consortium led by Fajr Capital owns a 65% stake in the GCC (Middle East) business while the Moopen family retains 35%, and in India, the Moopen family holds a 41.88% stake. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aster_DM_Healthcare)

- **Founder:** Dr. Azad Moopen started the parent company in 1987. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aster_DM_Healthcare)

- **GCC (Middle East) Operations:** Controlled by a partnership between a Fajr Capital-led investor consortium (65%) and the Moopen family (35%). [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aster_DM_Healthcare)

- **India Operations:** Publicly traded with the Moopen family retaining a major stake of about 41.88%

, and pharmacies run via brand licenses or subsidiaries.
